Coverage: Cross-country typical-day profiles before, during and after lockdown; the source retains an unresolved [Number] placeholder for the country count. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: The unresolved country-count placeholder prevents a precise coverage claim. Normalized typical profiles do not preserve every raw demand event. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
